title: BBK BBK Worker compact result payload v2
description: Closed compact role-specific result payload for `bbk_worker`. Use FULL when material truth cannot fit these fields.

work_unit_ref.description: Exact WorkUnit identity, revision, digest, governed subject, supported outcome or experiment obligation, phase or slice references, predecessor or repair reference, currentness, and invalidation state.

changed_artifacts.description: Every created, changed, renamed, deleted, generated, vendored, executable, configuration, documentation, test, fixture, package, migration, integration, cleanup, or other artifact with exact path or locator, prior-state guard where material, final byte count and SHA-256 where material, purpose, owning WorkUnit, and retention or successor disposition.

checks_and_evidence.description: Focused and completion checks with assertion or WorkUnit link, applicability, command or method, tool and version, environment and inputs, exit or observation state, complete output or evidence references, path/bytes/SHA-256 where material, limitations, skipped or unavailable status, and exact claims supported and not supported. No independent-validation claim is permitted.

claims_established_and_not_established.description: Exact bounded claims supported by current Worker actions and self-check evidence, plus material claims explicitly not established. Worker execution must never be represented as independent validation, candidate acceptance, finding closure, experiment conclusion, outcome achievement, or release.

cleanup_and_residuals.description: One allowed cleanup state plus temporary scaffolding, processes, packages, credentials, services, workspaces, devices, remote state, evidence retention, quarantine, residual owner, and any cleanup blocker or deferred obligation.

blockers.description: Typed technical, authority, decision, capacity, host-window, ownership, integrity, payload, context, profile, tool, environment, cleanup, recovery, or parent-direction blockers with evidence, affected scope, containment, and work that remains safe to continue.

x-bbk-full-detail-triggers: Consequential assurance or protected-floor exposure requires detail beyond the compact fields.
Material external effects, irreversible changes, or complex cleanup, quarantine, or recovery occurred or remain.
Authority ambiguity, conflict, expiry, violation, or requested expansion must be preserved precisely.
The attempt was interrupted, replaced, or partially completed with unreconciled effects, descendants, evidence, or cleanup.
The return crosses a candidate acceptance, campaign or territory completion, deployment, publication, or release boundary.
The parent explicitly requested FULL detail.
Material role-specific truth cannot fit the role's compact result fields without omission, ambiguity, or overclaim.
